newsitem.title: INDIA: Delhi shares surge on prospects of political peace.
newsitem.headline: Delhi shares surge on prospects of political peace.

text.p: Delhi share prices closed higher in hectic trade on Thursday as investors bought on expectations that the political impasse would be resolved soon, brokers said.
The Delhi Stock Exchange's sensitive index closed 9.16 points higher at 769.88.

"While foreign investors indulged in picking up stocks of blue chip companies, other players preferred to wait for the political developments in the United Front's steering committee meeting to elect its new leader," said Manoj Choraria of brokers Choraria Investments.
The United Front's steering committee will meet on Friday at 9.30 p.m. (1600 GMT) to discuss replacing caretaker Prime Minister H.D. Deve Gowda as its leader, spokesman Jaipal Reddy said.
Reliance Industries ended 14.15 rupees higher at 281.90.
State Bank of India was up 11.25 rupees at 297.25.
Oriental Bank of Commerce gained 2.95 rupees at 75.70.
Larsen and Toubro was up 7.65 rupees at 220.50.
